description: This file defines the JsonGrainStorageSerializer class, which implements the IGrainStorageSerializer interface to serialize and deserialize grain storage data using Newtonsoft.Json via OrleansJsonSerializer.

classes.name: JsonGrainStorageSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for grain storage that uses Newtonsoft.Json via OrleansJsonSerializer.
